findings.source_passage: These people were mad. There was no other explanation for their behavior. They believed they were in some fantasy land of lords and ladies with damsels in distress.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'I pulled my sleeve down to hide the mark'
findings.why_it_matters: The source gives the narrator's full sardonic internal diagnosis in three sentences; the draft collapses this to a single em-dash clause ('They were mad—lords and ladies, damsels in distress'), losing the dry, deliberate rhythm and the 'no other explanation' beat that establishes her voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the three-sentence interior monologue verbatim or near-verbatim: 'These people were mad. There was no other explanation for their behavior. They believed they were in some fantasy land of lords and ladies with damsels in distress.'

findings.source_passage: I didn't dare breathe. The ground came closer, but so did the other windows. I stopped above one of the illuminated ones.
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'I slipped over the window frame'
findings.why_it_matters: The terse, staccato rhythm of this three-sentence descent sequence builds tension through sentence-level pacing; the draft merges the action into a single clause ('I swung over the sill and slid. I stopped level with a lit window'), losing the breath-held beat.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'I didn't dare breathe' as a standalone sentence before 'The ground came closer.'

summary: No high-severity signature losses; two medium-severity voice flattenings (the sardonic internal diagnosis and the 'Medieval bullshit' line) and one low-severity rhythm loss are present, falling below the regeneration threshold of three mediums only marginally.
